traceability.notes:
The story 010.3-DEV-MIGRATE-TO-IMPLEMENTS describes a new optional ESLint rule (e.g., traceability/prefer-implements-annotation) that should: - Emit configurable warnings or errors when @story + @req annotations are used (default: off). - Provide an auto-fix that converts a single @story with one or more @req lines into a single @implements line, preserving JSDoc structure and relative ordering. - Detect multi-story or mismatched @req patterns and warn without auto-fixing. - Allow configuration of severity (off/warn/error) and remain fully backward compatible when disabled. - Be covered by tests and documented as a migration guide with configuration examples.
In the current repository state: - Only validation support for @implements (story 010.2) exists; there is no dedicated migration/recommendation rule. - No auto-fix logic converts @story/@req to @implements. - No configurable severity or configuration keys for such a rule exist. - No tests or documentation concretely implement or validate the behavior specified in story 010.3.
Because multiple core acceptance criteria are not satisfied (optional warning, auto-fix support, single-story conversion, multi-story detection, configurable enforcement, documentation, and associated tests), this story is not implemented. The correct assessment status is FAILED.
